What is royal power libre gpx?

Royal Power Libre GPX is a motorcycle brand launched in Pakistan by Royal Power Group in partnership with Thailand's GPX. The Libre line includes the Libre 125 and Libre 150 commuter bikes, priced at around Rs. 325,000 and Rs. 375,000. The Libre 150 has a 150cc air-cooled engine, a 17-litre fuel tank, roughly 40 km/L fuel economy, and a front disc brake.
